description: This Java source file implements an Android InputMethodService (IME) that provides an on-screen keyboard with buttons to insert image content (GIF, PNG, WebP) into the currently focused input field. It handles content commit requests, checks MIME type support, manages file resources, and grants appropriate URI permissions for sharing images via content URIs.

classes.name: ImageKeyboard
classes.description: An Android IME service that allows users to insert image content (GIF, PNG, WebP) into input fields via dedicated buttons.

methods.name: isCommitContentSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current input editor supports committing content of a specified MIME type.

methods.name: doCommitContent
methods.description: Prepares and commits a content item (image file) to the input connection, managing URI permissions and validation.

methods.name: validatePackageName
methods.description: Validates that the package name associated with the current input is trustworthy and matches the calling UID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the IME, loading image files from raw resources into files accessible for content sharing.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and configures the input view layout with buttons for inserting different image types.

methods.name: onEvaluateFullscreenMode
methods.description: Indicates that the IME does not support fullscreen mode to prevent content from being hidden.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Enables or disables content insert buttons based on support for specific MIME types in the current editor.

methods.name: getFileForResource
methods.description: Utility to load raw resource images into files in the app's file directory for content sharing.
